description: Counts of dentist practices (tannlegeklinikker) in Norway: the total, per county (fylke), and how many have Helfo direct billing, belong to a chain, show an emergency claim (akutt) or list a specialist. An emergency claim is «Akuttvakt», an emergency duty backed by a stored quote from the source, or «Tar imot akuttpasienter», that the clinic says it takes emergency patients.
name: tannlege_stats
title: Norwegian dental market statistics
